T: Everything comes to life after dark. Including dinner.
D: A new night guard at a natural history museum finds the exhibits come alive after closing.
P: Serve the mains when the T. rex skeleton wants to play fetch.
S: Octavius and his tiny Roman army
Marinated olives warmed with lemon peel and oregano, served with crusty bread torn for dipping in good olive oil and balsamic.
the T. rex who plays fetch with a bone
Pizza dough rolled into ropes, knotted at both ends into bone shapes, brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Marinara dip.
the Easter Island head who wants gum gum
Watermelon cubes skewered with mint and feta, finished with a squeeze of lime and a pinch of flaky salt, served very cold.
M: the street cart outside the museum
Franks simmered in water with onions, in steamed buns with spicy brown mustard, sauerkraut and onions in a tomato sauce.
Jedediah and Octavius, the tiny cowboy and the Roman
Two little boards: mini beef sliders with cheddar and pickles for the cowboys, and lamb kofta spiced with cumin and mint, grilled hot and served with tzatziki, for the Romans.
W: the monkey who keeps stealing Larry's keys
Ripe bananas mashed with melted butter, brown sugar and eggs, flour and bicarb folded in, baked at 170C for an hour, sliced and toasted with butter.
K: Drip coffee made strong, poured into a thermos with milk and sugar, sipped through the night.

s.note: the T. rex who plays fetch with a bone
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 12 ropes and knot both ends into bone shapes. Brush with 50g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and sprinkle with 40g parmesan. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes 10 minutes to dip.

s.note: the Easter Island head who wants gum gum
s.how: Cut a quarter of a watermelon and 200g feta into cubes. Thread onto skewers with a mint leaf between. Squeeze over the juice of a lime and add a pinch of flaky salt just before serving very cold.

m.note: the street cart outside the museum
m.how: Soften 2 sliced onions in oil for 15 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of water and cook down. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes. Put in steamed buns with spicy mustard, warm sauerkraut and the onions.

w.note: the monkey who keeps stealing Larry's keys
w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 100g melted butter, 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs. Fold in 250g flour and 1 tsp bicarb. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for an hour. Cool, slice thick, toast and spread with butter.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water so it's strong. Stir in 200ml warm milk and sugar to taste. Pour into a thermos warmed with hot water first. Sip from the lid through the night shift.
